name: Amoebae
description: Shape-shifting protozoa that engulf bacteria - and, at a much lower rate, flagellates, a within-channel link noted by the source commentary. Functional group aggregating all soil amoeba species, counted together in the source's samples. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in kg C per hectare, yearly average, from Table A1 of van Altena et al. 2016.
